summary: Interpreted the successor receipt and corrected the account. Receipt 9125b6a531234e7d9d2fa8cbb817df63 (same harness lineage with a third case added; all three tests passed) reproduced the re-synchronization witness (leader decided 7 with accepted 6, reconfiguration endpoint false, decided log unreadable: events 22, 23, 24) and isolated its two consequences: with only node 1 re-synchronized, node 1 alone ended at accepted 7 over the same six indices of content with decided 6, so its own reconfiguration endpoint flipped from true to false, its read of the StopSign's index 5 returned None while index 6 returned the StopSign, and its decided-log read from 0 returned an empty list where it had returned six elements (event 35); nodes 2 and 3 stayed at 6/6 with a six-element read and is_reconfigured true (events 36, 37), so the leader's decision at index 7 requires a write quorum of inflated reports. Declared comparisons matched: single-case comparisons 3-6 violated at index 35, leader-side comparisons 7-8 hold at index 37, and the baseline that index 6 held no StopSign before the re-synchronization holds at index 19. Updated records: the interpretation now covers both receipts (violated/asserted) with joint_history stating the two runs are read separately and not combined, counterevidence and limitations including the narrowing that the sealed configuration admits no further entries so no value is mis-assigned; the index-shift behavior was generalized to both observed decided-index positions and the decided-log read effect (one element with a quorum, empty list with a single report); a behavior was added for the leader deciding the reported accepted index without bounding it to its own log, and a sourced fact for the inflation's applicability condition (the resume point covering the StopSign's index, independent of the snapshot option because the snapshot branch derives sync_idx from get_decided_idx_without_stopsign); one gap was registered for the snapshot-enabled branch and for a new leader applying a follower's LogSync. Incomplete: that gap's execution, no snapshot-enabled run yet, the internal accepted-index vector behind the leader's phantom decision, and any independent second defect lead.
